report: [DATE]: MR Knie Links 15ch AA: Klinische inlichtingen: Zie gescande aanvraag Diagnostische vraagstelling: Zie gescande aanvraag Bevindingen: Matig tot gevorderd femoropatellair kraakbeenlijden, met volledig kraakbeenverlies laterale deel van de laterale facet van de trochlea met onderliggende subchondrale bot veranderingen onder vorm van botoedeem, kleine geode, fissuren op de crista patellaris en de trochleaire groeve met onderliggende vorming van subchondrale geode's. Matige opzetting suprapatellaire recessus. Dysplasie femoropatellaire dysplasie, met onderontwikkeld / quasi afwezig lateraal en mediaal facet trochlea, trochleaire hoek geschat op 158 \'b0. Horizontale degeneratieve scheur van het corpus en de posterieure hoorn van de mediale meniscus, met aanliggend botoedeem en erosie van de mediale boord van het tibiaplateau. Kruisbanden en laterale banden intact. Enkele oppervlakkige fissuren mediaal femorotibiaal kraakbeen . Besluit: - Matig tot gevorderd femoropatellair kraakbeenlijden, graad 3 \'e0 4 . - Onderliggende femoropatellaire dysplasie . - Beginnend mediaal femorotibiaal kraakbeen lijden, graad 2. - Degeneratieve horizontale scheur mediale meniscus, met beperkt aanliggend botoedeem en erosie mediale boord tibiaplateau. - Matige popliteale kyste.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Left knee pain and swelling after fall. Medial joint line pain. Suspected bone contusion/meniscal tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The medial meniscus is intact.

High-grade partial-thickness tear involving the anterior cruciate ligament near the femoral attachment. No anterior tibial translation. Osteochondral impaction injury posterior lateral tibial plateau and posterior medial tibial plateau without evidence of displacement and osteophyte fragment. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

Low-grade partial-thickness tear involving the proximal fibers of the superficial and deep medial collateral ligament. The distal fibers are intact. The posterior oblique ligament is intact.

The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. The iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 12 minutes, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the patellofemoral compartment. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Small knee joint effusion. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. High-grade partial-thickness tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
2. Low-grade partial tear of the medial collateral ligament.
3. Osteochondral impaction injuries posterior medial tibial plateau and posterior lateral tibial plateau without evidence of displaced or unstable osteochondral fragment.
4. Mild patellofemoral chondrosis.
5. Intact menisci.

Knochenmarksignal unauffällig. Keine frische Fraktur. Kreuzbänder intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Verdacht auf initiale unterflächenseitige Auffaserung des Innenmeniskus am Übergang der Pars intermedia zum Hinterhorn (5/7). Flächig mäßige Chondropathie femorotibial medial. Fokal mäßige Chondropathie an der Trochlea femoris links (7/14). Initiale Osteophyten retropatellar. Minimal Tendinopathie des Ligamentum patellae im Ursprung und der Quadrizepssehne am Ansatz bei hier auch kleinem Enthesiophyten. Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. Kaum flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste. Kein Anhalt für einen Reizzustand des Tractus iliotibialis.

There is diffuse high grade and low grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. 
  
 The lateral compartment, the lateral meniscus is not torn. There is focal high grade chondral defect (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) (about intact6* intact6 cm). There is no subchondral edema.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial trochlea, medial and lateral patellar facets. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.

 The extensor mechanism is normal.
